user.title: Add a student
user.description: Sign in with the student's Göteborgs Stad account (the one used for "Inloggning för personal och elever" on Vklass).

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Vklass no longer accepts the password for {username}.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Vklass or Göteborgs Stad's login. See the log for details.

init.title: Calendar subscription
init.description: While Vklass blocks the sign-in, yclass reads the calendar subscription instead: lessons and homework/tests, but no lunch, days off or homework texts. Paste the guardian's calendar subscription link from Vklass (https://cal.vklass.se/….ics?custodian=true). Leave empty to not use it.

error.invalid_ical: Could not read a calendar from that link.
